scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @argusvene/contracts && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @argusvene/contracts && npm run build --workspace @argusvene/api && npm run build --workspace @argusvene/web
scripts.check: npm run build --workspace @argusvene/contracts && npm run check --workspace @argusvene/api && npm run check --workspace @argusvene/web
